acceptance_gate.condition: online_adaptation_helps + best_adaptive_minus_static_delta + best_adaptive_minus_static_ci95 + arm_deltas reported with a positive-control headroom check AND verifier_is_oracle=false, OR an honest blocked_pools_missing verdict

field_principles.arm_deltas: Per-arm cross-family delta (static / online / tier2_memory / tier2_retrieval) -- shows WHICH adaptation tier helps (and that tier-2 is no longer a no-op).
field_principles.best_adaptive_minus_static_ci95: Powered bootstrap CI95 (>=2000 resamples) of the best-adaptive-minus-static delta -- excluding 0 makes 'helps' decision-grade; including 0 retires the ask.
field_principles.best_adaptive_minus_static_delta: BARE float: (best of online/tier2-memory/tier2-retrieval) - static -- the load-bearing self-learning gain (compare to the .397 +0.067).
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A powered 'online adaptation helps' (CI95-excl-0), a powered null (static is genuinely the ceiling), and an honest blocked_pools_missing are ALL COMPLETE and decision-grade.
field_principles.model_specs: The four arms + the cross-domain pools + the retrieval mechanism + the bootstrap protocol; required methodology.
field_principles.online_adaptation_helps: BARE bool: the capstone reads this (gated-fields-must-be-bare); true iff best-adaptive - static > 0 AND its powered CI95 excludes 0 -- cheap Tier-1/Tier-2 adaptation beats the static selector, decision-grade (not the .397 unpowered delta).
field_principles.positive_control_headroom: Oracle-minus-vote headroom on the same cross-domain tasks -- the FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK guard that makes a null informative instead of degenerate.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition for the adaptation order + bootstrap.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the arms + the cross-domain pools + the bootstrap; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- online/retrieval reweighting of a learned selector, NO executable oracle, NO weight mutation.

tier1_online.hardware_path: CPU counter updates; FPGA-friendly integer counters

tier2_memory.hardware_path: CPU/system-memory cache lookup; FPGA-friendly pattern match

tier2_retrieval.selector: Exp4295 retrieval-only nearest seen-family curated context

bootstrap_protocol.best_arm_selection: highest adaptive cross-family delta before CI read

provenance.vote_oracle_pattern: mode0 vote-correct, mode1/2 wrong-majority, mode3 no-oracle

retrieval_mechanism.current_family_feedback: not visible until after that family is scored

field_principles.adaptation_curve: Per-family (best-adaptive - static) gain as families stream in -- shows whether adaptation compounds (the continuous-self-learning signature) or is flat.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. An adaptive gain AND a now-bug-free static-is-the-ceiling null are BOTH COMPLETE -- both valid self-learning findings (the bug-free null retires the ask).
field_principles.model_specs: The Tier-1 reweighting rule + the FIXED Tier-2 memory rule + the Tier-2 retrieval rule + the combined family stream; required methodology.
field_principles.online_adaptation_helps: BARE bool: true iff the best adaptive selector (online / tier2-memory / tier2-retrieval) exceeds static AND the (adaptive-static) CI95 excludes 0 with power -- the self-learning value verdict the .396 tier-2 bug could not settle.
field_principles.online_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the online-reweighted selector's delta -- the Tier-1 self-learning result.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition; the family stream order + reweighting reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the folds + reweighting + memory + retrieval trace; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.static_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the static set-encoder's held-out-family delta -- the no-adaptation baseline.
field_principles.tier2_memory_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the FIXED constraint-memory selector's delta -- MUST differ from static (the .396 no-op bug is fixed).
field_principles.tier2_not_noop: BARE bool: true iff at least one tier-2 arm differs from static on >=1 family -- the explicit guard against repeating the .396 tautology (a tier-2 arm identical to static is a bug, not a finding).
field_principles.tier2_retrieval_cross_family_delta: BARE float: the retrieval-augmented selector's delta -- the Decocted-style no-weight-mutation arm.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- learned selector with online weight updates + a pattern cache + retrieval, no demo execution and no fine-tuning.

set_encoder_config.architecture_note: Permutation-equivariant DeepSets scorer: per-candidate MLP embedding, mean/max pooled full-set context, and per-candidate logits conditioned on that context.
set_encoder_config.cross_candidate_conditioning: vote priors, self-consistency margins, modal-grid agreement, duplicate counts, shape/palette family indicators, and DeepSets mean/max latent pooling over all candidates
set_encoder_config.imbalance_loss: class_weighted_bce_with_positive_task_minibatches; negative-only tasks are scored held-out but do not form training minibatches
set_encoder_config.set_attention_reference: CPU-fast fallback for the Set-LLM set-attention-mask / Set-Encoder cross-candidate attention lever; still consumes the full candidate set without positional features.

tier1_online_reweighting_rule.current_family_feedback: not used until after every task in that family is scored

tier2_memory_rule.cache: per-family ranked selector-arm pattern with per-arm precision context
tier2_memory_rule.current_family_feedback: cached only after every task in that family is scored
tier2_memory_rule.hardware_path: CPU/system-memory cache lookup, FPGA-friendly pattern match
tier2_memory_rule.lookup: reuse nearest already-seen family's cached ranked pattern
tier2_memory_rule.no_op_guard: tier2_not_noop requires memory or retrieval candidate differs from static

tier2_retrieval_rule.conditioning: average retrieved per-arm precision context, then select among cached candidate nominees
tier2_retrieval_rule.hardware_path: CPU/system-memory vector lookup, FPGA-friendly approximate nearest-neighbor path
tier2_retrieval_rule.retrieval: k=3 nearest seen-family contexts by feature profile distance

acceptance_gate.condition: cross_domain_delta>0 AND CI95-excl-0 AND vote_at_1>0.05 AND oracle_at_k<1.0 AND cross_domain_delta<0.95 AND label_ablation_robust

field_principles.cross_domain_delta: BARE float: held-out-DOMAIN router+set_encoder@1 - vote@1 -- compare to the within-ARC +0.40/+0.50 (a positive held-out-DOMAIN delta is the cross-domain moat).
field_principles.cross_domain_selection_holds: BARE bool: the capstone reads this (gated-fields-must-be-bare); true iff held-out-DOMAIN router+set_encoder@1 - vote@1 > 0 AND CI95-excl-0 AND non-degenerate guards AND label_ablation_robust -- the strongest selection result (escapes the math/ARC domain bound).
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A cross-domain survive (the moat escapes the domain bound), a collapse (the moat is domain-bound), a label-ablation failure (the router read the label), and an honest blocked_insufficient_domains are ALL COMPLETE and decision-grade.
field_principles.label_ablation_robust: BARE bool: true iff held-out accuracy SURVIVES removing the domain/family label from the router input -- the anti-leak proof (the moat must use task structure, not domain identity).
field_principles.model_specs: The 3-domain provenance + the router + per-domain set-encoder + the domain-disjoint split + the label-ablation protocol; required methodology.
field_principles.oracle_at_k: BARE float: positive-control ceiling on the held-out domain -- MUST be < 1.0 (a sub-1.0 ceiling is real headroom the verifier must earn).
field_principles.per_domain_delta: The lift reported SEPARATELY per held-out domain (arc / arcgen / fover) -- guards the one-domain-dominates failure mode.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition; the cross-domain sampling + domain-split reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the cross-domain pool + the domain manifest + the router; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- a learned router+set-encoder over cross-domain pools, no demo execution.
field_principles.vote_at_1: BARE float: the vote baseline on the held-out domain -- MUST be > 0.05 (if 0, the pool is wrong-majority-only and the delta is degenerate).

label_ablation.protocol: domain_id and family_id removed from router input; task/candidate features only

missing_verifier_gaps.candidate_design: DG-PRM-style multi-invariant verifier dimensions with a learned task-structure router validated on held-out fover
missing_verifier_gaps.missing_discriminator: domain-invariant selector features that preserve wrong-majority recovery across ARC, ARC-GEN, and FoVer/math step candidates without using domain labels

provenance.vote_oracle_pattern: mode0 vote-correct, mode1/2 wrong-majority, mode3 no-oracle

model_specs.label_ablation_protocol: rerun held-out routing with domain_id/family_id unavailable; label_ablation_robust requires held-out accuracy to survive within tolerance and delta to remain positive

per_domain_set_encoder.kind: standardized correct-minus-wrong set profile over Exp 4244 features
per_domain_set_encoder.training_scope: train domains only for each leave-one-domain-out read

router.input_features: task-level means of Exp 4244 candidate features
router.label_features: domain/family labels allowed only in primary arm; held-out domain remains domain-disjoint
